title: Calaamadda Dhagaxyada Dhexdooda
intro: Dhul buuro lagu xardhay guryo, waxaa yimid rasuul calaamad mucjiso ah ka keenay Alle. Dadku waxay dalbadeen caddayn, waxayna heleen xayawaan dhagax adag laga keenay. Laakiin kibirkoodu wuxuu ku kallifay inay ka hor yimaadaan digniinta, taasoo shaabadaysay qaddarkooda.
clues: Waxaa la ii diray dad ku noolaa guryo laga soo qoday buuro.
Waxay igula taliyeen inaan calaamad keeno, sidaas darteed waxaan ka soo saaray geel dhagax ah.
Waxaan ku amray inay si xor ah u cabbaan geela oo aysan wax u dhimin.
Way caasiyeen oo way gowraceen awrkii, iyagoo ka hor yimid digniintaydii.
Waxaan ku dhawaaqay in ciqaabtu ay imaan doonto saddex maalmood ka dib.
Subaxdii, qarax xooggan ayaa burburiyay, laakiin aniga iyo kuwa raacsan ayaa la badbaadiyay.

trial.label: Tijaabo/Dhacdo
options: Baahida loo qabo geel ka timid dhagax
Baahida loo qabo weyl dahab ah
Baahida loo qabo miis samada ka soo baxa
Baahida loo qabo in ul ay noqoto abeeso
trial.answer: Baahida loo qabo geel ka timid dhagax

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verse: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting. (27:45)
